tweets.text:
American agriculture is competing on the world stage once again — and we are winning! 🇺🇸🏆

The Trump Administration inherited a nearly $50 BILLION ag trade deficit. In just one year, we’ve already cut that deficit by nearly 40%. A massive turnaround for American farmers, ranchers, and producers. 📉

March #ag exports hit $16.8 BILLION, up 5% over last year, driven by surging exports of soybeans, corn, sorghum, ethanol, dairy, tree nuts, and other U.S. products.  

@POTUS’ trade agenda is delivering real results for our hardworking farmers, ranchers, and producers across this country:

📈Tree nut exports ↑44%  
📈Soybean exports ↑22%  
📈Sorghum exports ↑571%  
📈Ethanol exports ↑16% 
📈Dairy exports reached a RECORD $4.8 BILLION 

We’re also seeing strong growth in key markets around the world:  

🌎 EU exports ↑14%  
🌎Vietnam exports ↑21%  
🌎 Mexico exports ↑4%  
🌎 South Asia exports ↑15% 
 
Every single day we’re opening markets, expanding access, and creating new opportunities for American agriculture. I’m so proud of our incredible farmers and ranchers who make all of this possible.

tweets.text:
Spot on @VP, fraud is NOT a victimless crime!

Fraudsters aren’t the victims, the victims are the single mom between jobs trying to put food on the table, or the widowed husband giving Uber rides just to make ends meet. These scammers have ruined it for the families who truly need SNAP.

💰$3 BILLION in benefits have been stolen from those in need, including through:

⚰️ 186,000 deceased Americans with active accounts

🔄 355,000+ duplicates

With @OIGUSDA and the @WHFraudTF, we’ve made nearly 1,000 arrests and received MILLIONS in restitution and fines. And a lot of people will be paying the price.

We’re restoring SNAP for the Americans who need it most. There is still much work to do and this is just the tip of the iceberg.

tweets.text:
500 days of @POTUS. 🇺🇸

There’s still much more to do, but real progress is being made. And we’re just getting started.

For too long, farmers were an afterthought in the White House. Today, they’re back where they belong: at the center of policymaking.

We’re delivering huge progress — from landmark trade deals that are opening new markets and putting real money back in producers’ pockets to sweeping regulatory relief and historic support for American agriculture.

We will work every single day over the next 2.5 years to deliver even more wins for the farmers, ranchers, and producers who feed, fuel, and clothe America. And we will not slow down.

tweets.text:
🚨Trump to China will go down as a truly HISTORIC state visit! 

CONFIRMED WINS FOR U.S. FARMERS: 

1. $17B in NEW purchase commitments, in addition to the 25MMT soybean commitment.

2. U.S. poultry will be back on the table in China, as they are resuming U.S. imports.

3. U.S. beef is also on the menu, as China is renewing licenses for more than 400 beef facilities, and is adding new listings. This was the #1 “ask” by our ranchers who want to sell many of the “leftover” cuts of the animal (hides, skins, tongues, tendons, tripe, etc) for additional value. 

As the United States continues to diversify our overall exports this agreement provides stability in one of our largest markets.

tweets.text:
Strong leadership and REAL results from @TheJusticeDept and @DAGToddBlanche.  

For too long, Agri Stats’ information-sharing practices equipped major meatpackers to play with prices on chicken, turkey, and pork — squeezing our producers, weakening their negotiating power, and sometimes leaving consumers holding the bill.  

Today we’re leveling the playing field so every level of the food supply chain operates fairly and meat prices go DOWN.📉🐓🐖  

This historic settlement with Agri Stats is exactly the kind of decisive action American families and farmers have been waiting for.  

Grateful to partner with DOJ and the states to protect both our farmers and American consumers.
